a: पादः — [पद्यते गम्योऽनेन करणे कर्मणि वा घञ्] 1 The foot (whether of men of animals); तयोर्जगृहतुः पादान् R. 1. 57; पादयोर्निपत्यः पादपतित &c. The word पाद at the end of comp. is changed to पाद् after सु and numerals; i. e. सुपाद्, द्विपाद्, त्रिपाद् &c.; and also when the first member is used as a standard of comparison, but is a word other than हस्ति &c.; see P. V. 4. 138-140 e. g. व्याघ्रपाद्. The nom. pl. of पाद is often added to names of persons or titles of address to show great respect or veneration; मृष्यंतु लवस्य बलिशतां तातपादाः U. 6; जीवत्सु तातपारेषु 1. 19; देवप दानां नास्माभिः प्रयोजनं Pt. 1; so एवमाराध्यपादा आज्ञापयंति Prab. 1; so कुमारिलपादाः &c. --2 A ray of light; बालस्यापि रवेः पादाः पतंत्युपरि भूभृतां Pt. 1. 328; Śi. 9. 34; R. 16. 53 (where the word has sense 1 also). --3 The foot or leg of an inanimate object, as of a bed stead. --4 The foot or root of a tree; as in पादप. --5 The foot of a mountain, a hill at the foot of a mountain (पादाः प्रत्यंतपर्वताः); Me. 19: Ś. 6. 16. --6 A quarter, fourth part; as in सपादो रूपंकः ‘one and one-fourth rupee’: Ms. 8. 241; Y. 2. 174. --7 The fourth part of a stanza, a line. --8 The fourth part of a chapter or book, as of the Adhyāyas of Pāṇini, or of the Brahma Sūtras. --9 A part in general. --10 A column, pillar. --11 A foot as a measure equal to twelve Aṅgulis. --12 The quadrant of a circle. --Comp. --अग्रं the point or extremity of the foot; s: klI, (pAdaprakzAlanajAtaM udakam । SAkapArTivAdivat samAsaH .) caraRaDOtajalam । caraRAmftam । yaTA, -- “hfdi rUpaM muKe nAma nEvedyamudare hareH । pAdodakaYca nirmmAlyaM mastake yasya so'cyutaH ॥ nEvedyamannaM tulasIvimiSraM viSezataH pAdajalaM pibecca । yo'SnAti nityaM prayato murAreH prApnoti supremayutAM sa Baktim ॥ hatyAM hanti yadaNGrisaNgatulasIsteyaYca pAdodakaM nEvedyaM bahumadyapAnaduritaM gurvvaNganAsaNgamam । BaktyADInamatiH sTitirharijane tatsaMgatiH saNgajA SAlagrAmaSilAdimUrttimahitAM jAnanti ke vE hareH ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe 100 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ aTa SrIcaraRodakABizekamAhAtmyaM padmapurARe । “sa snAtaH sarvvatIrTezu sarvvayajYezu dIkzitaH । SAlagrAmaSilAtoyEryo'BizekaM samAcaret ॥ gaNgAgodAvarIrevAnadyo muktipradAstu yAH । nivasanti satIrTAstAH SAlagrAmaSilAjale ॥ kowitIrTasahasrEstu sevitEH kiM prayojanam । tIrTaM yadi Bavet puRyaM SAlagrAmaSilodBavam ॥” tatrEva gOtamAmbarIzasaMvAde । “yezAM DOtAni gAtrARi hareH pAdodakena vE । ambarIza ! kule tezAM dAso'smi vaSagaH sadA ॥ rAjannetAni tAvacca tIrTAni Buvanatraye । yAvanna prApyate toyaM SAlagrAmABizekajam ॥” skAnde kArttikamAhAtmye । “gfhe'pi vasatastasya gaNgAsnAnaM dine dine । SAlagrAmaSilAtoyEryo'BiziYcati mAnavaH ॥” tatrEvAnyatra । “yAni kAni ca tIrTAni brahmAdyA devatAstaTA । vizRupAdodakasyEte kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm ॥ SAlagrAmodBavo devo devo dvAravatIBavaH । uBayoH snAnatoyena brahmahatyA nivarttate ॥” kiYca । “sa vE cAvaBftasnAtaH sa ca gaNgAjalAplutaH । vizRupAdodakaM kftvA SaNKeyaH snAti mAnavaH ॥” SrInfsiMhapurARe । “gaNgAprayAgagayanEmizapuzkarARi puRyAni yAni kurujANgalayAmunAni । kAlena tIrTasalilAni punanti pApaM pAdodakaM BagavataH prapunAti sadyaH ॥” smftO ca । “trirAtriPaladA nadyo yAH kAScidasamudragAH । samudragASca pakzasya mAsasya saritAM patiH ॥ zaRmAsaPaladA godA vatsarasya tu jAhnavI । pAdodakaM Bagavato dbAdaSAbdaPalapradam ॥” tannityatA ca garuqapurARe । “jalaYca yezAM tulasIvimiSritaM pAdodakaM cakraSilAsamudBavam । nityaM trisanDyaM plavate na gAtraM Kagendra ! te DarmmabahiskftA narAH ॥” aTa SrIcaraRodakapAnamAhAtmyam । pAdme gOtamAmbarIzasaMvAde । “hareH snAnAvaSezantu jalaM yasyodare sTitam । ambarIza ! praRamyoccEH pAdapAMSuH pragfhyatAm ॥” tatrEva devadUtavikuRqalasaMvAde । “ye pibanti narA nityaM SAlagrAmaSilAjalam । paYcagavyasahasrEstu sevitEH kiM prayojanam ॥ kowitIrTasahasrEstu sevitEH kiM prayojanam । nityaM yadi pibet puRyaM SAlagrAmaSilAjalam ॥ SAlagrAmaSilAtoyaM yaH pibedvindunA samam । mAtuH stanyaM punarnEva sa pibenmuktiBAgnaraH ॥” kiYca । “dahanti narakAn sarvvAn garBavAsaYca dAruRam । pItaM yEstu sadA nityaM SAlagrAmaSilAjalam ॥” tatrEva SrIyamaDUmraketusaMvAde । “SAlagrAmaSilAtoyaM vindumAtraM tu yaH pibet । sarvvapApEH pramucyeta muktimArge kftodyamaH ॥” tatrEva pulastyaBagIraTasaMvAde । “pAdodakasya mAhAtmyaM BagIraTa ! vadAmi te । pAvanaM sarvvatIrTeByo hatyAkowivinASanam ॥ Dfte Sirasi pIte ca sarvvAstuzyanti devatAH । prAyaScittantu pApAnAM kalO pAdodakaM hareH ॥” kiYca । “triBiH sArasvataM toyaM saptAhena tu nAmadam । sadyaH punAti gANgeyaM darSanAdeva yAmunam ॥ punantyetAni toyAni snAnadarSanakIrttanEH । punAti smaraRAdeva kalO pAdodakaM hareH ॥ arccitEH kowiBirliNgErnityaM yat kriyate Palam । tat PalaM SatasAhasraM pItEH pAdodakErhareH ॥ aSucirvA durAcAro mahApAtakasaMyutaH । spfzwvA pAdodakaM vizRoH sadA SudDyati mAnavaH ॥ pApakowiyuto yastu mftyukAle Sire muKe । dehe pAdodakaM yasya na prayAti yamAlayam ॥ na dAnaM na haviryezAM svADyAyo na surArccanam । te'pi pAdodakaM pItvA prayAnti paramAM gatim ॥ viSAKAfkzasaMyuktA vESAKI kiM karizyati । piRqArake mahAtIrTe ujjayinyAM BagIraTa ! ॥ mAGamAse prayAge tu snAnaM vE kiM karizyati । prayAgaM satataM tasya yasya pAdodakaM hareH ॥ kArttike kArttikIyoge kiM karizyati puzkare । nityantu puzkaraM tasya yasya pAdodakaM hareH ॥ praboDavAsare prApte maTurAyAYca tasya kim । nityaYca yAmunaM snAnaM yasya pAdodakaM hareH ॥ kASyAmuttaravAhinyAM gaNgAyAntu mftasya kim । yasya pAdodakaM vizRormuKe cEvAvatizWate ॥” kiYca । “hitvA pAdodakaM vizRoryo'nyatIrTAni gacCati । anarGyaratnamutsfjya lozwraM vAYCati durmmatiH ॥ kurukzetrasamo deSo vindupAdodakaM mataH । pated yatrAkzayaM puRyaM nityaM Bavati tadgfhe ॥ gayApiRqasamaM puRyaM puttrARAmapi jAyate । pAdodakena devasya ye kuryyuH pitftarpaRam ॥ nAsurARAM BayaM tasya pretajanyaM na rAkzasam । na rogasya BayaM cEva nAsti viDnakftaM Bayam ॥ na duzwA nEva GorAkzAScApadotTaBayaM nahi । grahAH pIqAM na kurvvanti vErA naSyanti dAruRAH ॥ kiM tasya tITagamane devarzIRAYca darSane । yasya pAdodakaM mUrdDni SAlagrAmaSilodBavam ॥ prIto Bavati mArttaRqaH prIto Bavati keSavaH । brahmA Bavati suprItaH prIto Bavati SaNkaraH ॥ pAdodakasya mAhAtmyaM yaH paWet keSavAgrataH । sa yAti paramaM sTAnaM yatra devo janArddanaH ॥” brahmARqapurARe SrIbrahmanAradasaMvAde । “prAyaScittaM yadi prAptaM kfcCraM vA tvaGamarzaRam । so'pi pAdodakaM pItvA SudDiM prApnoti tatkzaRAt ॥ aSOcaM nEva vidyeta sUtake mftake'pi ca । yezAM pAdodakaM mUrdDni prASanaM ye prakurvvate ॥ antakAle'pi yasyeha dIyate pAdayorjalam । so'pi sadgatimApnoti sadAcArErbbahizkftaH ॥ apeyaM pibate yastu BuNkte yaScApyaBojanam । agamyAgamanA ye vE pApAcArASca ye narAH । te'pi pUjyA BavantyASu sadyaH pAdAmbusevanAt ॥” kiYca । “apavitraM yadannaM syAt pAnIyaM cApi pApinAm । BuktvA pItvA viSudDaH syAt pItvA pAdodakaM hareH ॥ taptakfcCrAt paYcagavyAt mahAkfcCrAdviSizyate । cAndrAyaRAt pAdakfcCrAt parAkAdapi suvrata । kAyaSudDirBavedASu pItvA pAdodakaM hareH ॥ aguruM kuNkumaM cApi karpUraM cAnulepanam । vizRupAdAmbusaMlagnaM tadvE pAvanapAvanam ॥ dfzwipUtantu yattoyaM vizRunA praBavizRunA । tadvE pApaharaM puttra ! kiM punaH pAdayorjalam ॥ etadarTamahaM puttra ! SirasA vizRutatparaH । DArayAmi pibAmyadya mAhAtmyaM viditaM mama ॥ priyastvamagrajaH puttra tvadarTaM gaditaM mayA । rahasyaM me tvanarhasya na vaktavyaM kadAcana ॥ DArayasva sadA mUrdDni prASanaM kuru nityaSaH ॥ janmamftyujarAduHKErmokzaM yAsyasi puttraka ! ॥” vizRuDarmmottare । “sadyaH PalapradaM puRyaM sarvvapApavinASanam । sarvvamaNgalamaNgalyaM sarvvaduHKavinASanam । duHsvapnanASanaM puRyaM vizRupAdodakaM SuBam ॥ sarvvopadravahantAraM sarvvavyADivinASanam । sarvvotpAtapraSamanaM sarvvatApanivAraRam ॥ sarvvakalyARasuKadaM sarvvakAmaPalapradam । sarvvasidDipradaM DanyaM sarvvaDarmmavivardDanam ॥ sarvvaSatrupraSamanaM sarvvaBogapradAyakam । sarvvatIrTasya PaladaM mUrdDni pAdAmbuDAraRam ॥ prayAgasya praBAsasya puzkarasya ca sevane । pfTUdakasya tIrTasya AcAnto laBate Palam ॥ cakratIrTe PalaM yAdfk tAdfk pAdAmbuDAraRAt ॥ sarasvatyAM gayAyAYca gatvA yat prApnuyAt Palam । tat PalaM laBate SrezWaM mUrdDni pAdAmbuDAraRAt ॥” skAnde । “pAdodakasya mAhAtmyaM devo jAnAti SaNkaraH । vizRupAdacyutA gaNgA SirasA yena DAritA ॥ sTAnaM nEvAsti pApasya dehinAM dehamaDyataH । savAhyAByantaraM yasya vyAptaM pAdodakena vE ॥ pAdodaM vizRunEvedyamudare yasya tizWati । nASrayaM laBate pApaM svayameva vinaSyati ॥ mahApApagrahagrasto vyApto rogaSatErapi । hareH pAdodakaM pItvA mucyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥ SirasA tizWate yezAM nityaM pAdodakaM hareH । kiM karizyanti te loke tIrTakowimanoraTEH ॥ ayameva paro Darmma idameva paraM tapaH । idameva paraM tIrTaM vizRupAdAmbu yat pibet ॥” tatrEva SivomAsaMvAde । “vilayaM yAnti pApAni pIte pAdodake hareH । kiM punarvizRupAdodaM SAlagrAmaSilAplutam ॥ viSezeRa haret pApaM brahmahatyAdikaM priye ॥ pIte pAdodake vizRoryadi prARErvimucyate । hatvA yamaBawAn sarvvAn vEzRavaM lokamApnuyAt ॥ tatrEva SivakArttikeyasaMvAde SAlagrAmaSilAmAhAtmye । “Cinnastena mahAsena । garBavAsaH sudAruRaH । pItaM yena sadA vizRoH SAlagrAmaSilAjalam ॥ ye pibanti narA nityaM SAlagrAmaSilAjalam । paYcagavyasahasrEstu prASitEH kiM prayojanam ॥ prAyaScitte samutpanne kiM dAnEH kimupozaREH । cAndrAyaRESca tIrTESca pItvA pAdodakaM SuciH ॥ bfhannAradIye lubDakopAKyAnAramBe । haripAdodakaM yastu kzaRamAtraYca DArayet । sa snAtaH sarvvatIrTezu vizRoH priyatarastaTA ॥ akAlamftyuSamanaM sarvvajADivinASanam । sarvvaduHKopaSamanaM haripAdodakaM SuBam ॥” tatrEva tadupAKyAnAnte । “haripAdodakasparSAllubDako vItakalmazaH । divyaM vimAnamAruhya munimenamaTAbravIt ॥ haripAdodakaM yasmAnmayi tvaM kziptavAn mune । prApito'smi tvayA tasmAttadvizRoH paramaM padam ॥” hariBaktisuDodaye । “pAdaM pUrvvaM kila spfzwvA gaNgABUt smarttfmokzadA । vizRoH sadyastu tatsaNgi pAdAmbu kaTamIzyate ॥ tApatrayAnalo yo'sO na SAmyet sakalAbDiBiH । drutaM SAmyati so'lpena SrImadbizRupadAmbunA ॥ aGAstrABedyakavacaM BavAgnistamBanOzaDam । sarvvANgEH sarvvaTA DAryyaM pAdyaM SucisadaH sadA ॥ amftatvAvahaM nityaM vizRupAdAmbu yaH pibet । sa pibatyamftaM nityaM mAse mAse tu devatAH ॥ mAhAtmyamiyadityasya yo vaktA so'pi nirBayaH । na tvanarGyamaRermUlyaM kalayannaGamaSnute ॥” anyatrApi । “sa brahmacArI sa vratI ASramI ca sadA SuciH । vizRupAdodakaM yasya muKe Sirasi vigrahe ॥ janmapraBftipApAnAM prAyaScittaM yadIcCati । SAlagrAmaSilAvAri pApahAri nizevyatAm ॥” ataeva tejodraviRapaYcarAtre SrIbrahmoktam । “pIWaplaRAlAdudakaM pfTagAdAya puttraka ! । siYcayenmUrdDni BaktAnAM sarvvatIrTamayaM hi tat ॥” iti । “pAdodakasya mAhAtmyaM viKyAtaM sarvvaSAstrataH । leKituM SaknuyAt ko hi sinDUrmIn gaRayannapi ॥ viSezataSca pAdodaM tulasIdalasaMyutam । SaNKe kftvA vEzRaveByo dattvA prAgvat pibetsvayam ॥” aTa SaNKakftapAdodakamAhAtmyaM skAnde brahmanAradasaMvAde । “kftvA pAdodakaM SaNKe vEzRavAnAM mahAtmanAm । yo dadyAttulasImiSraM cAndrAyaRaSataM laBet ॥ gfhItvA kfzRapAdAmbu SaNKe kftvA tu vEzRavaH । yo vahet SirasA nityaM sa munistApasottamaH ॥” pAdme devadUtavikuRqalasaMvAde । “SAlagrAmaSilAtoyaM yadi SaNKaBftaM pibet । hatyAkowivinASaM tu kurute nAtra saMSayaH ॥” agastyasaMhitAyAYca । “SAlagrAmaSilAtoyaM tulasIdalavAsitam । ye pibanti punastezAM stanyapAnaM na vidyate ॥ SrIvizRorvEzRavAnAYca pAvanaYcaraRodakam । sarvvatIrTamayaM pItvA kuryyAdAcamanaM na hi ॥” taduktaM skAnde SrISivena । “vizRoH pAdodakaM pItvA paScAdaSuciSaNkayA । AcAmati ca yo mohAdbrahmahA sa nigadyate ॥” SrutiSca । “BagavAn pavitro BagavatpAdO pavitrO pAdodakaM pavitraM na tatpAna AcamanIyaM yaTA hi soma iti .” sOparRe ca । “vizRupAdodakaM pItvA BaktapAdodakaM taTA । ya AcAmati saMmohAt brahmahA sa nigadyate ॥” iti SrIhariBaktivilAsaH ॥
